name: pimatrix
description: Raspberry Pi video routing and processing control plane

scripts.build: npm run generate:api && npm run build --workspace @pimatrix/api-client && npm run build --workspace @pimatrix/web && npm run build --workspace @pimatrix/api && npm run build --workspace @pimatrix/cli
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @pimatrix/api && npm run test --workspace @pimatrix/cli
scripts.lab:logs: docker compose -f dev/streaming-lab/compose.yaml logs -f mediamtx test-patterns
